name: island-road-material-check
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY;let hits=[];a.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.material?.userData?.islandLaneRoadMaterial)hits.push(o.name)});if(!hits.length)throw Error('Island road material not bound to actual scene');const l=C.islandRoadMaterialLayout();if(!l.supported)throw Error('Unsupported road layout');console.log('[island-road-material] '+JSON.stringify({meshes:hits,layout:l}));})()

name: island-canopy-source-check
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY,s=C.islandResidentialCanopyEzStats,l=C.islandResidentialCanopyLayout();if(!l.supported||!s?.added)throw Error('No source canopy integrated');if(new Set(s.sourceIds).size!==s.added)throw Error('Duplicate source tree');if(s.sites.some(t=>!Number.isFinite(t.height)||t.height<4.5||t.height>34))throw Error('Invalid source tree height');console.log('[island-canopy] '+JSON.stringify({layout:l,runtime:s}));})()

name: island-yard-material-check
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,l=C.islandYardMaterialLayout();let hits=[];a.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.material?.userData?.islandYardMaterial)hits.push(o.name)});if(!hits.length||!l.supported)throw Error('Yard material not integrated');if(l.eligible.length!==3||l.eligible.some(b=>b.matchedN<3||b.id===2917))throw Error('Unexpected yard eligibility');console.log('[island-yard] '+JSON.stringify({meshes:hits,layout:l}));})()
